conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The definition is total over all valid algebraic and topological inputs; no junk-value conventions are needed.

facts.statement: ∀ (R M M' N ι : Type*) [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [TopologicalSpace M] [AddCommMonoid M'] [Module R M'] [TopologicalSpace M'] [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] [TopologicalSpace N] (g : M [⋀^ι]→L[R] N) (f : M' →L[R] M) (v : ι → M') (i j : ι), i ≠ j → v i = v j → VTask.compContinuousLinearMap g f v = 0
